$comment: Chip-level GPIO rules. Sources: Espressif datasheets / ESP-IDF docs. Board-level facts live in data/boards/*.json.

esp32.name: ESP32
esp32.quad_psram_note: GPIO16/17 are taken by PSRAM on WROVER modules.

strapping.0: Boot mode (low at reset = download mode)
strapping.2: Boot mode (must be low/floating for download mode)
strapping.12: Flash voltage (MTDI). Pulled high at boot = 1.8V flash = boot failure on 3.3V flash modules

esp32.adc2_wifi_conflict: ADC2 cannot be read while Wi-Fi is running.

esp32s3.name: ESP32-S3

strapping.0: Boot mode (low at reset = download mode)

esp32s3.adc2_wifi_conflict: ADC2 may be unavailable or unreliable while Wi-Fi is active. Prefer ADC1 (GPIO1-10).

esp32c3.name: ESP32-C3

strapping.2: Boot mode (keep high for normal boot)
strapping.8: Boot mode (must be high for download mode via GPIO9)
strapping.9: Boot mode (low at reset = download mode)

esp32c3.adc2_wifi_conflict: ADC2 (GPIO5) is not recommended on ESP32-C3; use ADC1 (GPIO0-4).

strapping.8: Boot mode (must be high for download mode via GPIO9)
strapping.9: Boot mode (low at reset = download mode)
